entries.notes: Fully deprecated on npm since February 2020. undici (the HTTP client behind Node's global fetch) is the usual replacement; the API is different.
npm deprecation message: 'Node Sass is no longer supported. Please use sass or sass-embedded instead.' The sass package is the reference Dart implementation.
npm deprecation message says the module leaks memory and must not be used. Remove it; if you need to coalesce async requests by key, lru-cache is the suggested replacement.

In January 2022 the maintainer published versions containing an infinite loop on purpose. The last safe version is 1.4.0 (pin it if you must stay); picocolors is a small maintained alternative with a different API.
The maintainer deliberately removed the functional code in version 6.6.6. The community fork @faker-js/faker continues the project.
npm deprecation message: 'TSLint has been deprecated in favor of ESLint.' The repository is archived. Use ESLint with typescript-eslint.

The maintainers describe Moment as 'a legacy project in maintenance mode' and recommend alternatives for new projects: luxon (from the same team), date-fns, dayjs or the Temporal API. Existing code keeps working.
The README on npm opens with a DEPRECATION NOTICE from the author and points to yargs as the successor. Last release 2014.
npm deprecation message: 'this library is no longer supported'. It is almost always pulled in by request; removing request removes it.
npm deprecation message: 'This package is no longer supported.' Repository archived. Node's fs and stream modules cover the same needs today.

CVE-2024-29415 (SSRF via isPublic) affects every published version including the latest 2.0.1 and has no fixed release. Node's built-in net module covers isIP/isIPv4/isIPv6; for private-range checks use a maintained library.
Repository archived; last release 2015. Node's stream.Transform (and stream.pipeline) do the same job without a dependency.
Last release 1.3.7 in June 2015; it does not run on recent Python versions. pynose is a maintained fork that keeps the nose command-line and API; pytest is the mainstream alternative.
README: 'This project has been officially deprecated. You may want to check out platformdirs which is a more active fork of appdirs.'

PEP 680 states that toml 'is not actively maintained, does not support TOML 1.0.0 and has a number of known bugs'. Use tomllib (standard library, Python 3.11+) or tomli on older versions; tomli-w for writing.
Last release 0.6.2 in 2014. docopt-ng is 'a fork of the original docopt, now maintained by the jazzband community' with the same usage-string API.
RUSTSEC-2024-0436: 'paste - no longer maintained'; the repository is archived. pastey describes itself as the successor of paste and is a drop-in fork.
The last release is literally named 0.9.34+deprecated and the README says the project is no longer maintained. serde_yaml_ng is a fork from the last commit.
RUSTSEC-2024-0370: unmaintained since 2020, also pulls in the unmaintained syn 1. proc-macro-error2 is a maintained fork with the same API.
RUSTSEC-2024-0375: the maintainer published an official notice that the crate is no longer under development. std::io::IsTerminal (Rust 1.70+) replaces it.
The crate description itself says 'Unmaintained, consider using web-time instead'. web-time is a drop-in std::time replacement for Wasm in browsers.
RUSTSEC-2024-0320: 'yaml-rust is unmaintained'. yaml-rust2 is a fully YAML 1.2 compliant fork.
RUSTSEC-2021-0139: 'ansi_term is Unmaintained'. nu-ansi-term, maintained by the Nushell team, is the fork the advisory lists.
RUSTSEC-2024-0388: 'derivative is unmaintained; consider using an alternative'. derive_more and educe cover the same derives with different attribute syntax.
README: 'This crate is deprecated in favor of serde.' Repository archived. serde + serde_json replace it.
README: 'THIS PROJECT IS UNMAINTAINED'; the repository is archived. go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 is the fork adopted by the YAML organisation; github.com/goccy/go-yaml is an independent alternative.
The author archived several of his unmaintained projects; go-viper/mapstructure/v2 is the fork that documents the migration (a one-line import rewrite).
README: 'This project is archived.' HashiCorp maintains the fork under its own organisation.
README: 'Update, June 2023: This repo and tool are no longer maintained. Please see go.uber.org/mock for a maintained fork instead.'
README: 'THIS REPOSITORY IS NO LONGER MAINTAINED'; it also has an unfixed vulnerability (CVE-2020-26160). golang-jwt/jwt is the community fork endorsed by the original author.
README: 'this package is moving into maintenance mode' and 'is not accepting proposals for new functionality'; last release 2020. Go 1.13+ errors (fmt.Errorf with %w, errors.Is/As) covers wrapping.
Marked abandoned on Packagist with symfony/mailer as the declared replacement. README: 'Swiftmailer will stop being maintained at the end of November 2021.'
Marked abandoned on Packagist and the repository is archived. fakerphp/faker is the community fork that continued from the same code base.
Marked abandoned on Packagist. README: PHP 8 attributes 'are a native replacement for annotations'. Migrate docblock annotations to attributes.
Marked abandoned on Packagist. README: 'This library is deprecated and will no longer receive bug fixes'; use a PSR-6 or PSR-16 implementation such as symfony/cache.
